open_source.title: 1. Open Source Framework
open_source.content: Nirium is a set of open-source Soroban smart contracts deployed on the Stellar network. The interface provided here is merely a client explicitly interacting with decentralized protocols. By using this interface, you understand you are interacting with public blockchain infrastructure.

no_guarantees.title: 2. No Financial Guarantees
no_guarantees.content: The strategies, plugins, and autonomous agents available via Nirium are created by the community and rank entirely via the Sentinel ELO system. ELO rankings are historical data only and do not predict or guarantee future performance or financial outcomes. Purchasing a strategy subscription via USDC does not guarantee financial returns. Nirium does not offer investment contracts or yield-bearing securities.

hallucination.title: 3. Neural Matrix Volatility (Algorithmic Hallucination)
hallucination.content: Nirium agents consult a pluggable matrix of LLM providers (including OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Grok, MiniMax, etc.) for qualitative signal analysis. These models are experimental and can produce unpredictable, delayed, or factually incorrect outputs ('hallucinations'). Nirium bears zero liability for trading losses, missed arbitrage windows, or gas consumption resulting from LLM latency, API downtimes, or miscalculated signals.

fees.title: 4. Network Fees & Matrix Fee
fees.content: Users are responsible for all Stellar network operation fees. Additionally, by executing strategies through Nirium's algorithmic smart contracts, you agree to the 1% Protocol Matrix Fee. This fee is deducted atomically only from realized gross profit, not principal, as enforced by the smart contract code.

dispute.title: 5. Dispute Resolution & Governing Law
dispute.content: By interacting with the Nirium Protocol, you agree that any legal dispute or claim will be resolved exclusively through binding, confidential arbitration. You waive any right to bring or participate in a class action lawsuit against the developers or maintainers. These Terms are governed by the laws of the State of Mexico (Estado de México), Mexico.

risk_disclosure.mandatory: MANDATORY ACKNOWLEDGEMENT: You are using algorithmic, highly experimental open-source software.

execution.title: 1. Autonomous Execution Risks
execution.content: By delegating vault operations to AI agents or community-published strategy logic, you are authorizing code to execute autonomous financial transactions on the Stellar network. While the Soroban smart contracts utilize atomic, single-invocation wrappers ('Panic on loss' protection), systemic failures, oracle manipulation, or extreme lack of liquidity can result in total loss of funds.

custody.title: 2. Use At Your Own Risk
custody.content: Nirium does NOT take custody of your funds. All capital is stored in non-custodial Vault smart contracts controlled by your cryptographic keys. As such, the developers, maintainers, and creators of Nirium bear absolutely NO LIABILITY for any losses incurred.
